Product.Name: Oceanview II Swing Set
Product.Description: Inspire active play and imagination with Backyard Discovery’s Oceanview II Swing Set. This wooden swing set transforms outdoor spaces into an exciting play paradise that combines beach house style with adventure. A spacious upper clubhouse becomes the ultimate play headquarters, featuring wide windows, colorful curtains, and a welcoming balcony that sparks endless fun. A full wooden staircase and monkey bars provide exciting routes to the clubhouse, while the flat step ladder is perfect for kids of various climbing abilities. Underneath the clubhouse, a shaded hammock offers a comfy relaxation zone for little explorers taking a break from their exciting activities. The 10-foot wave slide delivers thrilling descents, complemented by two belt swings and a trapeze bar that promise non-stop outdoor excitement and endless play possibilities. A built-in growth board captures childhood milestones, creating a lasting memory of backyard adventures. Thoughtfully constructed from naturally durable cedar wood, this outdoor playset brings dynamic play time right to your backyard, inspiring creativity while encouraging climbing, swinging, and sliding. The Oceanview II Swing Set comes ready to assemble and offers guided instructions through the BILT® app, making it easy to transform your backyard into an extraordinary playground where imagination and active fun come together.

Product.Description: Kids can playfully explore and dream up adventures on the Fall River Swing Set from Backyard Discovery. Designed with upper and lower play areas, this wooden swing set features an elevated clubhouse complete with a canopy roof, creating the perfect hideaway where kids can plan their next quest. The lower play space is designed with a full front door, offering a welcoming spot that feels like their very own little home. A spacious side window designed with a snack bar becomes the perfect hang out spot where your little ones can serve up pretend treats or take refreshment breaks in between adventures. Kids can zoom down the 8-foot speedy wave slide, then soar toward the sky on two classic belt swings designed with rope chains that are gentle on little hands. Whether they're pirates sailing the high seas or astronauts exploring space, this backyard swing set transforms your yard into their favorite play space. Built from robust Nordic spruce and finished in a light brown stain, this playset brings natural charm and exceptional durability to your outdoor space. The Fall River Swing Set by Backyard Discovery is designed to inspire creative play through years of growth, imagination, and sky-high adventures.

Product.Name: Sweetwater Chicken Coop

Your hens will love the cozy nesting boxes that provide a safe and comfortable space to lay their eggs, while making collection easy and stress-free for both you and your birds. The roosting bars provide your chickens with a natural perch to sleep on at night, helping them feel secure and relaxed. Complete with windows and a full front locking door, the Sweetwater Coop makes it easy to care for your chickens while allowing natural light. Designed with charming farmhouse style, it features durable cedar construction finished in a modern white stain and a black galvanized steel roof that shields your birds from the elements. The Backyard Discovery Sweetwater Chicken Coop is perfect for perfect for families and homesteaders who want fresh eggs and happy chickens.
